title: Rowan Bell · Community Manager · call with Cassian Wheatbourne · September 2024
notice: Synthetic demo material. Invented document; no real meeting, publication, email or call occurred.

blocks.text: Spoke with Cassian. He wanted to check in after the storm. Says a band came through Violet Hills last week—not long, but fierce. Took out a dozen young apple trees he’d put in along the western edge. They were just getting established.

Lost the whole stand. Roots weren’t deep enough yet. Ground’s soft there. Wind just laid them flat. I’ll clear the wood for the smoker, but I’m not replanting apples in that spot. Thinking hazel, thick, for next season. Good for a windbreak, and we can use the nuts.
He mentioned another project, separate from the storm damage. He’s been working with Calla’s refill shop in the Junction Quarter.

Yeah, got a batch of dried rings ready. Calla wanted a bulk delivery, no fuss. We packed them in the reusable grain sacks—the heavy linen ones we use for milling. She’ll sell them by weight, customers bring their own containers. Saves her from dealing with a mountain of plastic wrappers. Dropped them off Tuesday.
